description: We are a creative and passionate team interested in developing innovative ideas and creating useful mobile applications. We believe in teamwork, sharing knowledge, and learning together to achieve our goals.
summary: The "Things Left Behind, Not Forgotten" project focuses on documenting and highlighting human and technological remnants left behind in space (such as space debris and abandoned exploration equipment) or neglected sites, bridging them with human memory and scientific history. The project addresses this challenge by designing an interactive digital platform or tool that utilizes space agency data to track these artifacts and present their stories through engaging visual storytelling. The project's importance lies in going beyond the technical management of space and environmental waste; it preserves human and scientific heritage from oblivion, documents humanity's early steps into the cosmos, and raises awareness about the critical importance of space and terrestrial sustainability.
details: Abandoned but Not Forgotten is an interactive web project built using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript. It explores abandoned space objects and missions across the Solar System. Using authentic data and resources from official NASA websites, the platform features an interactive planetary map that helps users discover forgotten spacecraft, explore their locations, and learn the stories and scientific value behind each object.
